EP47:E3 1800-8200 CATHERINE [Calculated, Defiant]: "Rupert is rotting in the undercroft cells. Not me. I intend to stay on this estate."

EP47:E16 31000-35200 JULIANA [Despairing]: "I am only a healer. The lords will never accept me."
EP47:E17 35500-37500 CAMERA: Profile shot as Alexander reaches out and firmly clasps Juliana's trembling hands in his own.
EP47:E18 35800-37800 ALEXANDER [Gentle, Resolute]: "Look at me, Juliana."

EP47:E26 56800-60000 CAMERA: Medium shot of Lady Ashbourne leaning heavily on her walking cane, glaring down at Catherine who kneels in the mud.

beats.description: In the estate chambers at night, Catherine states she intends to stay on the estate while Rupert is imprisoned.
A conspirator warns that Alexander will search the grounds and the council has blocked the marriage registry; Catherine orders him to keep her inside the walls and to keep the council paralyzed.
At morning, Juliana voices fear that the council will strip Alexander's title because of her and that lords will never accept her as a healer.
Alexander reassures Juliana that she is his wife and that they will stand before the King and God within ten days.
In the rain-soaked courtyard, Lady Ashbourne condemns the kneeling Catherine, who pleads that she has nowhere to go; Lady Ashbourne orders her cast into the road.
Vaughn readies to seize Catherine; Alexander arrives with Juliana and orders her thrown past the perimeter, and Catherine begs for mercy.
Juliana halts the guard; Alexander protests that Catherine tried to destroy her, and Juliana answers that Ashbourne does not throw beggars into the mud.
Juliana offers shelter only as a scullery maid, and Catherine recoils at the humiliation.
Juliana sets out the labor terms, including dawn hearth work and midnight kitchen work, and warns that a single complaint will cast Catherine out with nothing.
Catherine accepts the apron and keys and prostrates herself before Alexander, Juliana, and Lady Ashbourne as the scene cuts to black.
